stories.title: OpenAI says it will no longer train its AI models on the live internet, citing “significant risks”
stories.take: A sharp reversal — OpenAI will cut frontier models off from the live web weeks after its own engineer said that fix would not work.

stories.title: NASA updates lander plans for Moon landings, finally solves long-festering Orion issue
stories.take: NASA settled the lander plan and closed out the Orion problem that has dogged the Moon program — the return timeline gets firmer.

stories.title: Updated Google privacy policy says your Gmail might be used for advertising
stories.take: Google's new policy language opens the door to Gmail informing ads — read the fine print before you accept it.

stories.title: Lab testing giant Quest Diagnostics confirms patients’ personal and health data was compromised during breach
stories.take: Quest confirms patient personal and health data was taken — the latest in a run of healthcare breaches this year.

stories.title: Hegseth warns prediction market bets warp military judgment, endanger troops
stories.take: The Pentagon memo says insider bets on prediction markets put troops at risk — prediction markets now have a national-security problem.

stories.title: Elon Musk Just Dumped Another $76 Million Into the Midterms
stories.take: That pushes Musk past $445 million to Republican groups this cycle, as Democrats vow to investigate him.

stories.title: Intel gets waiver after worries fuzzy US ban on foreign-made robots may hit fabs
stories.take: Intel got a waiver so a vague ban on foreign-made robots does not stall its own chip fabs.

stories.title: Commonwealth Fusion Systems gets $85M to build better fusion-ready semiconductors
stories.take: An $85 million federal award for fusion conductors — the government is funding the supply chain, not just the reactor.

stories.title: Omnicom-IPG deal ‘substantially completed’ as group wins Coke’s NA media
stories.take: The mega-merger is essentially done, Coke's North America media is the prize, and $900 million in cost savings is on track.

stories.title: Omnicom’s $900M Cost Cutting Drive Continues in Q3 as Revenues Stay Flat
stories.take: Flat revenue, deep cuts — Omnicom's Q3 shows the holdco model shrinking its way to growth.

stories.title: McDonald’s Ends 32-Year FIFA World Cup Sponsorship Amid Marketing Overhaul
stories.take: After 32 years, McDonald's walks away from the World Cup — a landmark sponsorship ends in its marketing overhaul.

stories.title: Elon Musk Reportedly Invests $1 Billion Into Skydance After WBD Merger
stories.take: A reported $1 billion Musk bet on Skydance after the WBD merger — his media footprint keeps growing.

stories.title: The ambitious EA Sports rebrand looks great from every angle
stories.take: DixonBaxi's EAFC27 rebrand blends iconic sports branding with gaming culture — and it holds up from every angle.

stories.title: Olivia Rodrigo just showed creatives how to deal with false design allegations in style
stories.take: Accused of using AI, Rodrigo's team answered with process, not denial — a template for creatives facing the same charge.

stories.title: How Amazon Made a Stronger Partnership Play in Thursday Night Football in Year 5
stories.take: Year 5 of Thursday Night Football is less about streaming rights and more about partner integrations.

stories.title: Mavs' Flagg exits with sore shoulder after hard foul by Pacers' Nesmith
stories.take: Cooper Flagg left Friday's game at Indiana with left shoulder soreness after a hard foul — Dallas holds its breath.

stories.title: Co-defendant denies Billups gave him info, pleads guilty in NBA gambling case
stories.take: Eric Earnest pleaded guilty to wire-fraud conspiracy but denied Chauncey Billups fed him inside information.

stories.title: LeBron responds to Trump's criticism, calls it 'slow news day in office'
stories.take: LeBron brushed off Trump's anthem criticism as a slow news day — the feud stays cold, for now.

stories.title: Phishing email to Knicks employees an 'unfortunate mistake,' MSG says
stories.take: MSG admitted fault: staff got a fake championship-ring claim email while coaches got empty ring boxes on opening night.

stories.title: Why Warriors-Lakers was the quiet end of an incredible NBA era
stories.take: The LeBron–Curry rivalry that defined a decade is over — both teams are now in full transformation.

stories.title: NBA Sure Things: Three days into the new season, these nine things feel like guarantees
stories.take: Three days in, the safe bets are already clear — from Maxey pacing the 76ers to Dončić resting in LA.

stories.title: Follow live: Brewers extend lead on Chourio's RBI single, look to close out Game 1
stories.take: Milwaukee led Game 1 late on Jackson Chourio's RBI single — the small-ball Fall Classic opened in the Brewers' favor.

stories.title: Brewers' Misiorowski throws 103.5 mph pitch to set World Series record
stories.take: Jacob Misiorowski set the World Series velocity record with his very first pitch of the Series — 103.5 mph.

stories.title: Manfred: Small-market World Series good for game, but cap still needed
stories.take: Manfred praised a Rays-Brewers Series while still arguing small markets need a salary cap to compete regularly.

stories.title: Brewers' Woodruff, out since July, added to World Series roster
stories.take: Brandon Woodruff, out since July 4 with a shoulder injury, made the World Series roster in place of Chad Patrick.

stories.title: Rays opt for Martinez to start World Series over ace Rasmussen
stories.take: Tampa Bay's curveball: Nick Martinez, not ace Drew Rasmussen, started Game 1.

stories.title: Ohtani won't require surgery; Dodgers 'fully expect him to pitch next year'
stories.take: No surgery for Ohtani, and the Dodgers fully expect him to pitch in 2027 — the best news of LA's winter so far.

stories.title: Trump says he ordered suit to block Alaska Senate results if GOP loses
stories.take: Trump said it plainly — he ordered the lawsuit to block Alaska certification if the Republican loses, with Senate control in the balance.

stories.title: Severe flooding hits Four Corners region, more expected through the weekend
stories.take: Rooftop rescues and evacuations in the Four Corners, with more rain coming through the weekend.

stories.title: Ex-FBI employees charged with lying to Congress over Hunter Biden inquiries
stories.take: Two ex-FBI employees are charged with lying to Congress over the Hunter Biden laptop inquiries.

stories.title: 'There's babies in there': Oregon father describes stopping school shooter
stories.take: The Bend father who stopped the shooter describes the moment — and says he regrets the children he could not save.

stories.title: Medicare Advantage cuts leave millions scrambling to find coverage
stories.take: Insurers are pulling Medicare Advantage plans from markets, leaving millions hunting for new coverage.

stories.title: Aaron Rodgers says NFL’s Paris game is safe despite PSG cancellation amid unrest
stories.take: PSG cancelled amid Paris unrest, but Rodgers says the Steelers-Saints NFL debut in Paris on Sunday is safe to play.

stories.title: Ohio could decide control of the Senate. Its rural voters might decide the winner
stories.take: Reliably red Ohio is competitive this year — and rural voters who backed Republicans may decide the Senate.

stories.title: Seeking to help Collins in Maine, Trump exempts some Canadian imports from his 50% tariffs
stories.take: A tariff carve-out aimed squarely at Susan Collins' tight Maine race — trade policy as campaign help.

stories.title: 'This is not normal': Feds demand California counties set aside 'likely' noncitizen ballots
stories.take: The Justice Department told every California county to segregate ballots from voters it believes are noncitizens — election officials call it unprecedented.

stories.title: 9th Circuit blocks path for Trump to again deploy National Guard without state approval
stories.take: The 9th Circuit ruled last year's Guard deployment unlawful and blocked Trump from federalizing California troops over the state's objection again.

stories.title: San Bernardino County owes $51 million to mother of mentally-ill man killed by deputies, jury says
stories.take: A federal jury awarded more than $51 million to the mother of a man killed by San Bernardino deputies.

stories.title: The millions spent by California billionaires against Prop. 40 is about 0.07% of their wealth
stories.take: $293 million spent against the billionaire-tax measure sounds huge — it is 0.07% of the opponents' combined wealth.

stories.title: Mayor Karen Bass outpaces challenger Nithya Raman in fundraising for the Nov. 3 runoff
stories.take: Bass raised more, but Raman banked more for the final push — the LA mayor's runoff is a cash race too.

stories.title: Metrolink suspends iconic coastal route due to high tides
stories.take: High tides shut the Pacific Surfliner through South Orange County — the coastal route's climate problem in miniature.

stories.title: Midterm campaigning enters home stretch
stories.take: 22 million ballots already cast, and Trump is campaigning in deep-red states to turn out his base — at ~35% approval he motivates both sides, not persuades • Five toss-up Senate races sit in states Trump won by an average of 13 points in 2024, while Democrats have overperformed in special elections by ~13 points • A fabricated 'Wedgwood Polling' Michigan poll helped push a candidate out — fake polls also surfaced in Wisconsin and LA • Ohio's governor race turned ugly: a Ramaswamy ad featuring his opponent's estranged mother was condemned even by fellow Republicans
